target.title: fix(cron): purge orphaned cron_jobs rows on agent delete
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When an agent is deleted via CLI, `cron_jobs` rows referencing the deleted agent (by `agent_id` or `owner_agent_id`) are not cleaned up from the shared state SQLite database, leaving orphaned schedules.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds `purgeAgentCronJobs()` as a best-effort cleanup function called from the CLI agent-deletion fallback path (`agents.commands.delete.ts`).

The Gateway path (`deleteAgentConfigEntry`) is intentionally NOT wired here — the cron service owns loaded job state, persistence, timers, and events. Direct SQLite row deletion would bypass that lifecycle. A future PR should add a cron-service-owned bulk removal API for the Gateway path.

Uses Kysely expression builder `eb.or()` since `orWhere` is not available on `DeleteQueryBuilder`.

Note: `owner_agent_id` is a real column in the generated `CronJobs` type (`src/state/openclaw-state-db.generated.d.ts:346`): `owner_agent_id: string | null`. The `check-test-types` CI failure is from `extensions/anthropic/session-catalog.test.ts` (introduced by #107356), unrelated to this PR.

## Evidence

### Before (main) — orphaned cron data confirmed
```
$ sqlite3 ~/.openclaw/state/openclaw.sqlite \
  "SELECT job_id, name, agent_id, owner_agent_id FROM cron_jobs
   WHERE agent_id = 'proof-main-test' OR owner_agent_id = 'proof-main-test';"
proof-cron-1|test-cron|proof-main-test|proof-main-test
# Agent deleted via CLI, cron_jobs row remains
```

### After (fix) — purgeAgentCronJobs cleans up
```
$ sqlite3 ~/.openclaw/state/openclaw.sqlite \
  "SELECT job_id, name, agent_id, owner_agent_id FROM cron_jobs
   WHERE agent_id = 'proof-fix-test' OR owner_agent_id = 'proof-fix-test';"
# (empty — cron was purged during agent deletion)
```

### Tests
- `src/cron/store/purge-agent-cron-jobs.test.ts` — 3 tests
- `src/commands/agents.delete.test.ts` — 12 tests (including new "purges cron_jobs rows on agent delete")

## Files Changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/cron/store/purge-agent-cron-jobs.ts` | New: Kysely `eb.or()` based cleanup |
| `src/cron/store/purge-agent-cron-jobs.test.ts` | New: 3 unit tests |
| `src/commands/agents.commands.delete.ts` | +3: import + call in CLI fallback |
| `src/commands/agents.delete.test.ts` | +36: mock wiring + integration test |
